name: Pinions of Time
descriptionTemplate: Obtain [Power:Arg1] {STR}. Shuffle {derived:Twin Wings} into the Draw Pile.
lore:
That was a hollow, the only narrow void in infinite time and space.
The being known as "Keeper" is the answer to all questions, the key to all gateways.
Tawil resonated with six wings, lunging at that one and only.
